-- | Sudoku matem├ítico interactivo con pistas

--   MathDoku: Sudoku con pistas matemáticas (par/impar, primo, divisible).

@package MathDoku
@version 1.0.0.0

module MathDoku

module MathDoku.Core

-- | 9x9 Sudoku board with size invariant enforced by smart constructors
data Board

-- | Sudoku cell states
data Cell

-- | Empty cell available for filling
Empty :: Cell

-- | Pre-filled puzzle clue (1-9)
Fixed :: Int -> Cell

-- | User-filled cell (1-9)
Filled :: Int -> Cell

-- | Coordinate as row-column pair (0-8 range)
type Coord = (Int, Int)

-- | Puzzle difficulty levels
data Difficulty
Easy :: Difficulty
Medium :: Difficulty
Hard :: Difficulty
Expert :: Difficulty

-- | Empty 9x9 board with all cells in Empty state
emptyBoard :: Board

-- | Smart constructor that validates board dimensions and cell values
mkBoard :: [[Cell]] -> Either String Board

-- | Parse board from character grid representation <a>.</a> = Empty,
--   '1<a>-</a>9' = Fixed values
fromList :: [[Char]] -> Either String Board
unBoard :: Board -> [[Cell]]

-- | Get cell at specified coordinate (0-8 range) Throws error on
--   out-of-bounds access (programmer error)
getCell :: Coord -> Board -> Cell

-- | Extract numeric value from cell (Empty -&gt; 0)
cellValue :: Coord -> Board -> Int

-- | Convert cell to Maybe Int (Empty -&gt; Nothing)
cellToValue :: Cell -> Maybe Int

-- | Check if cell at coordinate is empty
isCellEmpty :: Coord -> Board -> Bool

-- | Create new board with cell updated at specified coordinate Original
--   board remains unchanged
setCell :: Coord -> Cell -> Board -> Board

-- | Place numeric value (1-9) at coordinate as Filled cell
placeValue :: Coord -> Int -> Board -> Board

-- | Extract all 9 rows as Cell lists
rows :: Board -> [[Cell]]

-- | Extract all 9 columns as Cell lists
cols :: Board -> [[Cell]]

-- | Extract all 9 3x3 boxes as Cell lists Uses block-row/block-column
--   indexing: br*3+r, bc*3+c
boxes :: Board -> [[Cell]]

-- | Check if placing value n at coordinate is valid Sudoku move
isValidMove :: Coord -> Int -> Board -> Bool

-- | Check if board is completely filled (no Empty cells)
isComplete :: Board -> Bool

-- | Validate complete board: no duplicates in any row<i>column</i>box
isValidBoard :: Board -> Bool

-- | Pretty-print board to console with box separators
printBoard :: Board -> IO ()
instance GHC.Enum.Bounded MathDoku.Core.Difficulty
instance GHC.Enum.Enum MathDoku.Core.Difficulty
instance GHC.Classes.Eq MathDoku.Core.Board
instance GHC.Classes.Eq MathDoku.Core.Cell
instance GHC.Classes.Eq MathDoku.Core.Difficulty
instance GHC.Classes.Ord MathDoku.Core.Difficulty
instance GHC.Read.Read MathDoku.Core.Cell
instance GHC.Read.Read MathDoku.Core.Difficulty
instance GHC.Show.Show MathDoku.Core.Cell
instance GHC.Show.Show MathDoku.Core.Difficulty

module MathDoku.GameState

module MathDoku.Solver

-- | Solve complete Sudoku using optimized backtracking
--   
--   Algorithm: 1. If complete, validate and return 2. Find next empty cell
--   3. Try valid candidates recursively
resolverSudoku :: Board -> Maybe Board

-- | Return coordinates of all empty cells using list comprehension.
--   Identical to Generator for maximum compatibility.
emptyPositions :: Board -> [Coord]

module MathDoku.Hints
data HintType
Parity :: HintType
Prime :: HintType
Divisible3 :: HintType
Divisible2 :: HintType
NarrowRange :: HintType
MediumRange :: HintType
Reveal :: HintType
data Hint
Hint :: Coord -> HintType -> String -> Int -> Hint
[hintCoord] :: Hint -> Coord
[hintType] :: Hint -> HintType
[hintMessage] :: Hint -> String
[hintValue] :: Hint -> Int
data HintError
CellAlreadyFilled :: Coord -> HintError
CellOutOfBounds :: Coord -> HintError
PuzzleHasNoSolution :: HintError
InvalidHintType :: HintType -> HintError

-- | Get hint for specific cell using solution
getHint :: HintType -> Board -> Coord -> Either HintError Hint

-- | All available hint types
getAllHintTypes :: [HintType]

-- | Hint cost in points
hintCost :: HintType -> Int

-- | Check if number is even/odd
isParity :: Int -> String

-- | Check if number is prime
isPrime :: Int -> Bool

-- | Check divisibility
isDivisibleBy :: Int -> Int -> Bool

-- | Check range
inRange :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Bool

instance GHC.Enum.Enum MathDoku.Hints.HintType
instance GHC.Classes.Eq MathDoku.Hints.Hint
instance GHC.Classes.Eq MathDoku.Hints.HintError
instance GHC.Classes.Eq MathDoku.Hints.HintType
instance GHC.Classes.Ord MathDoku.Hints.HintType
instance GHC.Read.Read MathDoku.Hints.HintType
instance GHC.Show.Show MathDoku.Hints.Hint
instance GHC.Show.Show MathDoku.Hints.HintError
instance GHC.Show.Show MathDoku.Hints.HintType

module MathDoku.Generator

-- | Generate a Sudoku puzzle of specified difficulty with guaranteed
--   unique solution.
--   
--   Algorithm: 1. Generate complete valid Sudoku grid using optimized
--   backtracking 2. Remove cells while preserving exactly one solution
generatePuzzle :: Difficulty -> IO Board

-- | Puzzle difficulty levels
data Difficulty
Easy :: Difficulty
Medium :: Difficulty
Hard :: Difficulty
Expert :: Difficulty

-- | Number of cells to remove for each puzzle difficulty level. Values
--   follow industry standards ensuring solvability with unique solution.
cellsToRemove :: Difficulty -> Int

-- | Return coordinates of all filled cells (Fixed or Filled).
filledPositions :: Board -> [Coord]
